material.acceptance_criteria: Pitch has a lower bound of 0 (or a small positive minimum) so the eye stays above the ground, and the clamp matches the documented contract.
material.description: render3d.js:120 documents eyeOf as pitch above the ground plane, and nearOf (render3d.js:134-137) assumes the nearest floor is in front of the eye. orbitCamera (render3d.js:196) clamps pitch to [-PITCH_LIMIT, PITCH_LIMIT], with PITCH_LIMIT = PI/2 - 0.01 (render3d.js:5). An upward shift or right-button drag (play.js:1227 orbit) takes pitch below 0, where eye height distance*sin(pitch) is below the target.

notes.note: Triage keep. Located: render3d.js:196 clamps pitch to [-PITCH_LIMIT, PITCH_LIMIT] (PITCH_LIMIT at :5), so pitch can go negative. Orbit reaches it through play.js:1227 (shift or right-button drag). With pitch below 0 the eye height target.y + distance*sin(pitch) is under the ground plane. Observable: an upward orbit drag past the horizon puts the camera under the floor.
